name: coreeffort
description: Picks the effort level each prompt needs, for code and office work, and asks before any switch to xhigh or max.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: suggest: ask before every change of level. auto: change by itself, but ask before xhigh and max. off: do nothing.

classifier.title: Classifier model
classifier.description: The model that reads each prompt and picks the level: sonnet (more accurate) or haiku (faster, cheaper).
